purpose: Exchange one source-bound processor observation without treating the producer's verdict as evaluation acceptance.

required.inputs: Nonempty list of role, path, sha256, bytes, revision and rights_scope. Original report, configuration, processor state and implementation source retain distinct roles.

rules: Absent values remain null or named missing; they do not become zero, identity or a default dataset.
A process completion is separate from the observation status.
An unchanged output can be legitimate only when the configured mode is explicit identity or the independently specified witness is a fixed point; byte equality alone is not acceptance.
Multiple suffix matches do not select a dataset. The record may enumerate them but selected_stats_key remains null without an explicit selector.
Producer observations do not grant semantic acceptance. Evaluation consumes this record under its separately committed expectations.
